name: rbb
description: RBB, Record Before Build: a Claude Code plugin. Agree what will change before the agent builds it, then check the code against that record, not against the agent's report.

plugins.name: rbb
plugins.description: Record Before Build: one page you approve, frozen before the build; a build held to it; a check by an agent that never met the builder; the page beside the code in the pull request.
